beats.care: If you live in a PG, ask your owner whether an MCD-listed engineer has checked the building. PGs without a certificate could be vacated and sealed.
beats.what: MCD told all 12 of its zones to collect structural safety certificates from over 2,400 PGs within 15 days.
beats.why: A PG building collapsed in Satya Niketan in September, killing seven people, five of them students. The Delhi High Court then ordered a survey.

cards.body: MCD told the High Court that the 2,453 PGs have more than 32,000 rooms.
cards.caption: people live in the surveyed PGs

cards.body: Civil Lines zone, which includes DU's North Campus, has 608 PGs. Keshavpuram has 410, South zone 390, Karol Bagh 365 and Satya Niketan 101.
cards.title: Where the PGs are

cards.body: Officials say just looking at a building can't show whether it will survive an earthquake. Engineers have to check the beams and columns.

opts: That it has a fire exit
That the building itself is strong enough to stay standing safely
That the rent is fixed by MCD
cards.q: What does a structural safety certificate tell you about a PG?
cards.why: A structural certificate covers the building's strength, such as its beams and columns. It says nothing about fire exits, taxes or rent.

cards.q: Before renting a PG, what do you check first?

hook: Is your PG building *actually certified safe*?

learn.t: In MCD's survey of 2,453 PGs, approved building plans could be traced for only about 30% of them.

sources.name: ThePrint (PTI)
sources.title: MCD seeks safety certificates from over 2,400 PGs within 15 days in Delhi

tldr: MCD has asked more than 2,400 PGs to get structural safety certificates within 15 days, or risk being sealed.
watch: Watch whether PG owners file certificates within the 15-day window. Officials say the deadline could be extended.
